name: Sjuhäradsleden, etapp 8: Prångens Camping - Böne kyrka
description: Prångens Camping to Böne kyrka. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Borås stage 8 prints Böne kyrka as 6416620 4120226, which is almost certainly an extra-digit easting typo. Borås stage 9, the GPX endpoint and the actual Böne kyrka area support 6416620 412026.
Current Borås page says Lätt, while older official brochure text says Lätt/medel.
Borås lists 15 km, Naturkartan page/geometry gives about 15.1 km, Naturkartan GPX part-sum is about 15.115 km and OSM about 15.053 km.

Naturkartan section 7 end, section 8 start and Borås/Prångens Camping access coordinates do not collapse to one point. Section 8 start is better aligned with OSM, while Borås access coordinate is closer to the campsite.
OSM has a spring at Jordkulan, but field evidence says the well appeared empty/unreliable. A 2025 report says Böne kyrka water was signed not drinkable.

Facilities lane found shelter sources suggesting sleeping/overnight use at Jordkulan, while rules lane recommends importing Jordkulan as rest shelter only until overnight permission/current condition is confirmed.

facilities.name: Prångens Camping & Stugby
facilities.description: Paid start facility cluster with camping/stugby, WC, water, showers, waste services, grill, cafe, parking, minigolf, playground and beach context. Treat utilities as guest/service-dependent rather than free trail utilities. Deduplicate with section 7 Prångens endpoint and Prångens badplats facilities.

facilities.name: Jordkulan i Nöre
facilities.description: 1800s earth-dug emergency dwelling/rest destination, inhabited until 1885 and open to visitors. Major section facility cluster with shelter, fireplace, picnic tables, toilet and waste nearby. Do not conflate the historic jordkula itself with the adjacent overnight shelter.

facilities.name: Jordkulan vindskydd
facilities.description: Shelter at the Jordkulan facility cluster. Some sources tag sleeping/overnight shelter, while rules lane advises importing Jordkulan as rest shelter only until overnight status is confirmed. Verify overnight permission/current condition before labeling as overnight accommodation.

facilities.name: Böne kyrka
facilities.description: Official endpoint church, an 1820s empire-style church on the site of a medieval predecessor. Church/interior access may be limited; 2025 field report found it locked. Do not imply interior access, toilet or potable water; apply churchyard conduct rules.

facilities.name: Böne kyrka parking
facilities.description: Parking at/near the route endpoint and church. Parking is the strongest Böne access; public transit is several kilometres away.
